task: Design versioning and evolution tracking system for the pointer network

avg_hops_per_route.interpretation: Routes got deeper — agents following longer pointer chains

success_rate.interpretation: Success rate dropped as routes got longer and more complex

primary.interpretation: Primary pointers less reliable in run-002 — possible misclassification or overuse

supporting.interpretation: Supporting pointers dramatically improved — better tool orchestration

run_001_to_run_002.top_entry_shift: SOP-027 dominated run-001 (19 routes), SOP-011 dominated run-002 (15 routes)
new_patterns_in_run_002: Wikipedia nodes appeared as exit targets (wiki-ai:AI-complete, wiki-ai:Neuro-symbolic_AI)
pointer-network.json itself became a navigable node

versioning_system_design.overview: A snapshot-based versioning system that captures network state at a point in time, enables structured diffs between any two snapshots, generates changelogs, and tracks schema migrations.

metrics.orphan_count: Nodes with no incoming or outgoing edges

snapshot_schema.node_ids: Sorted list of all node IDs
snapshot_schema.edges: Full edge list with from, to, weight, strength

diff_output.nodes_added: Node IDs present in B but not A
diff_output.nodes_removed: Node IDs present in A but not B
diff_output.edges_added: Edges in B but not A (by from+to key)
diff_output.edges_removed: Edges in A but not B
diff_output.edges_reweighted: Same edge, different weight — includes delta
diff_output.metric_deltas: Per-metric before/after/delta for all tracked metrics

connectivity.structure_hash_changed: Quick check if anything structural changed

entry_format.timestamp: When the later snapshot was taken
entry_format.summary_text: Human-readable change summary (e.g., +5 nodes, +12 edges, ~3 reclassified)

1.1.note: Current version. Added schema_version field, tag_clusters, and strength_levels.

new_fields.community_structure: Pre-computed community groupings for faster analysis

migration_rules: 1.0 -> 1.1: Add schema_version='1.1'. Existing data is forward-compatible.
1.1 -> 1.2: Add version_metadata from latest snapshot. Compute community_structure from tag_clusters.
Backward: 1.1 -> 1.0: Strip schema_version, tag_clusters, strength_levels. Data remains valid.
migration_safety: Diffs between compatible versions ignore missing optional fields
Unknown fields are preserved (not stripped) during diff
Schema version is validated on snapshot load

commands.snapshot [label]: Take a snapshot of current network state, saved to storage/pointer-routes/snapshots/
commands.diff <snap_a> <snap_b>: Compare two snapshots, output structured diff
commands.changelog: Generate changelog from all sequential snapshots
commands.latest: Show latest snapshot summary with diff from previous
commands.check-schema: Validate current schema, check migration compatibility
commands.list: List all snapshots with summary table

key_metrics_tracked: node_count — growth of the knowledge graph
classified_count / classification_ratio — how much of the network has been audited
recommendations: Run snapshots before and after each benchmark run to track network mutations
Automate snapshots via SOP hooks — every team that modifies pointer-network.json should snapshot first
The 81.6% unclassified edge ratio is the biggest improvement opportunity — classification campaigns should be tracked via changelog
Consider adding route_analysis data (success rates, top edges) to snapshots for correlated evolution tracking
When schema 1.2 is adopted, embed version_metadata directly in pointer-network.json for self-documenting evolution
